Work with product, engineering, data, architecture, security, and client teams to integrate AI systems into real workflows and enterprise environments. Continuously evaluate new models, agent frameworks, protocols, and development patterns, and turn useful capabilities into reusable engineering components. Strong software engineering and AI application fundamentals are the priority. Approximately 2-6 years of software, ML, AI, or product engineering experience, including meaningful hands-on work with Generative AI or LLM-powered applications. Strong Python programming skills and good software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous programming, testing, Git, packaging, and debugging. Understanding of production concerns including prompt injection, data leakage, access control, secrets, rate limits, token budgets, latency, reliability, observability, and cost management. Experience with durable execution concepts such as checkpoints, resumability, idempotency, timeouts, retries, error routing, long-running tasks, and human-in-the-loop review. Experience instrumenting agent traces and using evaluations and production feedback to understand failure modes and improve solve rate, reliability, usefulness, and cost. You can design and implement a multi-agent architecture with explicit orchestration, governed tools, state, evaluation, observability, and failure handling. You can diagnose why an agent fails on real tasks and improve the system using evidence from traces, evals, user feedback, and production behaviour. You make pragmatic choices between a simple deterministic workflow, a single agent, and a multi-agent system rather than adding agents where they are unnecessary. You create reusable technical patterns that help multiple product teams build safer and more reliable AI applications. What We Offer Opportunity to build AI, data, analytics, and digital products across Retail & CPG, Media & Entertainment, Sports, Energy, Telecommunications, and other industries. Hands-on work with frontier and enterprise foundation models, modern agent frameworks, and emerging AI development patterns. Opportunity to take AI solutions from prototypes through evaluation, enterprise integration, production deployment, and continuous improvement. Exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, and modern cloud-native AI technologies without being constrained to a single platform. A development path toward Senior Applied AI Engineer, AI Architect, Agentic AI Lead, or technical leadership roles.
